scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, boot the RAM Wi-Fi kernel, bring up espwifi0 and observe scan summaries, net80211 cache generations and scan-import diagnostics during the WPA profile's automatic scan activity.
expected: The scan callback uses the ESP32-S31 MAC-v3 RX layout, frames pass into the net80211 scan cache, and no ring or allocation failures occur.
observed: The net80211 scan cache reached 18 entries during automatic scanning. Ten scan summaries recorded zero IEEE80211 bad-version drops and no scan-ring-full, mbuf-allocation or node-allocation failures. The count is from the BSD scan cache, not the vendor callback's AP summary.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and RAM-only trial; this does not establish another board revision or persistent installation.
The scan-cache count is not a vendor AP summary and does not establish a count of distinct radio networks.

A strict SAE/PMF-required profile remained in SCANNING/ASSOCIATING. Its matching AP observation reported auth enum 7, but there was no IPv4 address or default route; no actionable supplicant authentication event established the failure stage.
WPA2/WPA3 authentication, DHCP, roaming and sustained transfer are not accepted.
